newsitem.title: USA: US FTC extends deadline for Staples merger.
newsitem.headline: US FTC extends deadline for Staples merger.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission on Friday agreed to extend its March 5 deadline in the merger between Staples and Office Depot by "about a week," a source close to the talks said.
The extension gives the two companies more time to negotiate with the FTC over the shape of the merger.
Earlier, the FTC signalled it was making the extension by announcing that a special Saturday meeting of its five commissioners had been cancelled.

Had the FTC met in the absence of an agreement between the government and the two office superstore chains, the commissioners might have voted on a proposal to seek court action halting the merger, sources close to the talks said.
Instead, talks will continue about what conditions should govern a merger of the two chains.
Later, Staples and Office Depot announced that the FTC extension would last until March 13.
